Package-level reference for the default UI, Svelte, React, preview, Mermaid, and extension exports.

## `@mira-mde/default-ui`

```ts
import {
  createMiraDefaultEditor,
  defaultMiraFeatures,
  MiraFeature,
  resolveMiraDefaultFeatures,
  resolveMiraDefaultToolbarItems
} from "@mira-mde/default-ui";
```

| Export | Purpose |
| :--- | :--- |
| `createMiraDefaultEditor` | Imperatively mount the default editor into a DOM node. |
| `MiraFeature` | Stable feature flag names. |
| `defaultMiraFeatures` | Default resolved feature map. |
| `resolveMiraDefaultFeatures` | Merge caller feature flags with defaults. |
| `resolveMiraDefaultToolbarItems` | Resolve built-in toolbar item availability. |
| `resolveMiraDefaultToolbarActions` | Merge custom toolbar actions. |
| `resolveMiraDefaultToolbarDefinitions` | Merge custom toolbar sections. |

## Packages

| :------------------------- | :---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `@mira-mde/default-ui`     | Default editor UI, toolbar, feature flags, and imperative mount helper. |

## Markdown Coverage

The demo and docs live examples cover the portable Markdown surface: frontmatter, headings, inline formatting, links, wikilinks, tags, Markdown embeds, lists, task lists, blockquotes, callouts, pipe tables, grid tables, fenced code, syntax highlighting, KaTeX math, images, raw HTML, directives, footnotes, and Mermaid diagrams.

## Modes

| Mode           | Behavior                                                               |
| :------------- | :--------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `source`       | Raw Markdown editing.                                                  |
| `live-preview` | CodeMirror editing with rendered widgets for inactive Markdown blocks. |
| `preview`      | Reading view backed by the same Markdown renderer.                     |
| `split`        | Editor and preview side by side.                                       |

## Source Toggle

Live widgets expose a source affordance when raw Markdown editing is needed. The editor restores the original source range and keeps focus in the CodeMirror surface.

| Widget                   | Live-preview behavior                                     |

| Frontmatter              | Collapsible properties editor with typed value controls.  |
| Callouts and blockquotes | Rendered block widget with source fallback.               |
| Tables and grid tables   | Editable rich table surface with row and column actions.  |
| Code blocks              | Highlighted block widget with language-specific behavior. |
| Math blocks              | KaTeX rendered widget with source fallback.               |
| Mermaid blocks           | Rendered diagram with controls and source fallback.       |
| Images and embeds        | Rendered media/embed preview with source fallback.        |

## Supported Markdown

| Feature              | Syntax                                                           |
| :------------------- | :--------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Frontmatter          | `---` YAML or TOML frontmatter blocks                            |
| Headings             | `#`, `##`, `###`, through `######`                               |
| Inline formatting    | `**bold**`, `_italic_`, `~~strike~~`, inline code                |
| Links                | `[label](target)`, autolinks, and internal path links            |
| Wikilinks            | `[[Target]]` and `[[Target\|Label]]`                             |
| Markdown embeds      | `![[Target]]` and `![[Target\|Label]]`                           |
| Tags                 | `#tag` and nested tags such as `#mira/docs`                      |
| Lists                | ordered, unordered, nested, and task lists                       |
| Task states          | `[ ]`, `[x]`, and custom task markers such as `[/]`              |
| Blockquotes          | regular blockquotes and Obsidian/Lapis callouts                  |
| Collapsible callouts | `[!note]+` and `[!note]-`                                        |
| Tables               | GFM pipe tables with alignment                                   |
| Grid tables          | reStructuredText-style grid tables                               |
| Code                 | inline code, fenced code, syntax highlighting, and copy controls |
| Math                 | inline `$...$` and block `$$...$$` through KaTeX                 |
| Images               | `![alt](src "title")` with asset resolver support                |
| Raw HTML             | preserved through the Markdown preview pipeline                  |
| Directives           | container, leaf, and text directives from `remark-directive`     |
| Footnotes            | GFM footnotes with backlink output                               |
| Mermaid              | fenced `mermaid` code blocks through `@mira-mde/plugin-mermaid`  |

## Portable Components

The renderer maps portable Markdown to reusable components for frontmatter, callouts, checkboxes, list items, links, wikilinks, tags, images, embeds, code blocks, tables, and Mermaid diagrams.

Application-specific vault panels, workspace sidebars, command registries, and file tree behavior stay outside the portable Markdown packages.

## Enable Mermaid

```ts
import { mermaidExtension } from "@mira-mde/plugin-mermaid";

const extensions = [mermaidExtension()];
```

`MiraDefaultMde` adds this extension automatically when `MiraFeature.Mermaid` is enabled.

## Behavior

- instance-safe render IDs
- responsive SVG layout
- hover controls
- copy source action
- expanded dialog
- pan, zoom, reset, and center controls
- source toggle back to the fenced code block
- optional rough/sketch rendering where supported by the plugin
